identity: one scout per document; claim assignment is agent_id modulo 20
memory: set of document IDs and authenticated withdrawn-root IDs, private per scout
attachment: 20 seeded positions, one per claim; independent view with no first-head response; agreement retains label, disagreement yields UNCERTAIN
communication: previous-round four-neighbor snapshot; evidence and optionally withdrawal tombstones
post_extraction_policy: deterministic source-balanced aggregation; no hidden model calls
cache: one frozen extraction tape per seed and arm, reused across paired counterfactual worlds
